comments.value: I like where it is now next to emoji, but I'd say it just shouldnt be visible if you dont have vrc+. I'd not want to see it if I dont have vrc+, but I'd also not want to have to go into an extra menu to access it since I do subscribe and will be using this a lot.

Regardless of VRC+ icons being on 90% of the pages of the main menu regardless if you have it..... 

Having a menu for chat/social functions submenu would be way more optimized than the unfairness of an essential button like chatbox behind the Options submenu, and the button that requires a paid subscription front and center. just IMO though.
I don't really think that makes sense
Maybe the stickers could be grouped under the current root emojis section but it's called "Emojis & Stickers". That way we have 1 submenu which takes us to all of our silly uploaded images.

I disagree. Reason being stickers and emojis are just different, with different settings and such. I like how they are in different menus. Now, I do think vrchat should give us more emojis, and the ability to have custom "sections" This way we can have more emojis and more stickers! I think that would make them having different sections just more useful and less bloated as it would simply surve a purpose.
Can probably mark this as in open beta, since they put the sticker tab under the Emojis tab which is now called “emojis and stickers”.
I hate this. I like having its own section, i use them way more than emoji

Three back-to-back movements on almost the opposite sides of the joystick to get to stickers now. This is killer for those of us with drift.

Before it was downleft then down.

details:
The radial menu is already incredibly bloated and frustrating to navigate. Adding an additional menu just conflates the issue more. However, stickers are much like Emojis and should be part of the Emojis section of the menu. 

At best its an advertisement for people to get VRC+ on the radial menu. However, its an annoying advertisement as well. It would still have the same advertising effect under emojis, because when you are using an emoji you are at least looking to share something.
title: [Stickers] Stickers should be grouped under Emojis instead of as their own group.
